intro.narration: [excited] Heey, ninety-five squared. In your head, in three seconds. Here's how.

steps.narration: [curious] Any number ending in five is fast to square. [pause] Take ninety-five.
[confident] Multiply the tens digit, nine, by the next number, ten. [pause] That's ninety.
[excited] Then stick twenty-five on the end. Ninety-five squared is nine thousand and twenty-five.

outro.narration: [warm] Save this one, and try it on your own number.
outro.display: Save this. Try it on yours.
